record_scope_reconstruction: The selected phase is the additional Kyrgyz conflict-related restriction on Tajik people/goods specifically at Kairagach and Kyzyl-Bel. The original May order listed five posts; the March 2025 endpoint is a formal reopening at these two only.

source_checks.finding: May 21 order lists five posts and scope of Tajik-national/goods restriction.
Kabar directly identifies Kairagach in Leilek and Kyzyl-Bel in Batken as the two formally reopened posts.
Contemporary reporting observes Tajik nationals turned back; distinct from pre-existing pandemic rules.
Official indexed Kairagach coordinate corroborates the border-control node; Kyzyl-Bel directory coordinate is too coarse/inconsistent and rejected.
